I wanted to share something that you may not be aware of and that you may enjoy...

In 1993, Art Bell broadcast his first Halloween special during the midnight hours, dedicated to sharing "true" ghost stories from the audience, on his wildly popular Coast To Coast AM radio show. The show was affectionately know as Ghost to Ghost.

That show was a phenomenal hit and stared an annual Halloween tradition for many people, including myself, of listening to four hours of ghost stories during the midnight hours of Halloween.

If you want to get into the "Halloween spirit" or if you're at the gym or just stuck doing a boring job during Halloween, I recommend listening in to the live broadcast or perhaps loading your iPod up with MP3s from previous years (see the links below).

Sure, many of the stories are corny, but most are fun and occasionally there's a legitimately creepy gem.

I recall listening many years ago to a story told by a Navy Officer about the strange occurrences on the Aircraft Carrier he was stationed at. He described a specific room in which all of the night duty staff would hear banging and screaming and begging... a room that was empty and remained that way due to the unexplained noises the Officers would hear during the night. The Officer remained anonymous, but did give his rank, the name of the warship and the years he was stationed there. Shortly afterwards, more Navy Officers who served on that ship phoned in to corroborate the story with specifics about the ship and to confirm they heard the sounds from that empty room too.

Unfortunately Art Bell retired late last year, but his replacement, Heather Wade, is presumably planning to continue the tradition of the Ghost to Ghost Halloween specials. A word of warning, Coast to Coast AM still do their own version of Halloween special each year, but George Noory's show (otherwise known as the Snoory Clown Show) never came close to the pure awesome that is Art Bell.

I also enjoy Darkness Radio paranormal podcasts and I'd be surprised if they don't do something special for Halloween.

If you weren't aware of this, then you may be in for a treat!

Happy Halloween everyone!
